title: Comprehensive Outcome Measures and Perioperative Morbidity After Cystectomy
summary: Radical removal of the urinary bladder with creation of a urinary diversion due to tumor disease represents an invasive procedure with a significant complication burden. The aim of this observational study is the standardized reporting of complications and patient-centered functional and oncological outcomes using established classification systems and questionnaires on disease-specific quality of life.

interventions.name: Radical cystectomy or cystoprostatectomy ± pelvic lymph node dissection ± anterior exenteration and urinary diversion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients capable of giving consent ≥18 years undergoing radical cystectomy (with anterior exenteration if necessary) or cystoprostatectomy with urinary diversion.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients unable to give informed consent, pregnant women and minors <18 years of age
